feed.title: NPR Topics: Business
feed.subtitle: Find the latest business news with reports on Wall Street, interest rates, banking, companies, and U.S. and world financial markets. Subscribe to the Business Story of the Day podcast.

entry.title: As crypto and prediction markets expand, their regulator shrinks
entry.summary: Even as the agency is tasked with drawing up new rules for crypto and prediction markets, its staffing and enforcement actions have dropped precipitously during the second Trump administration.

entry.title: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
entry.summary: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

entry.title: Who will win the 2026 Nobel Prize in economics?
entry.summary: A thinly traded prediction market offers a starting point. We explore potential winners and the big ideas that could earn them economics' biggest prize.

entry.title: Here's the latest sticker shock: Borrowing for a mortgage -- or a car
entry.summary: It's not just mortgages being at their highest level in almost three years — but the cost of loans for cars and higher education are among the borrowing costs affected, too.

entry.title: What voters in 6 key states could tell us about the 2026 midterms
entry.summary: Morning Edition is heading to Maine, Texas, North Carolina, Georgia, Ohio and Michigan to hear what voters say is shaping their choices ahead of the midterm elections.

entry.title: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
entry.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

entry.title: Disney, ABC battle Trump's FCC in court over free speech protections
entry.summary: President Trump has repeatedly called for Disney's ABC to fire late night comedian Jimmy Kimmel, for mocking him. Trump has also routinely denounced ABC's The View, accusing it of being unfair.

entry.title: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
entry.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

entry.title: G7 countries reluctantly agree to tap their fuel reserves to help the U.S.
entry.summary: G7 nations plan to release large amounts of diesel fuel soon, but European countries were not entirely happy about the agreement.

entry.title: She died covering war for Fox News. Her parents blame the network — and a star reporter
entry.summary: The family members of two Fox News journalists killed while covering the war in Ukraine are suing the network, saying it put getting the story ahead of its people.
